name: mion-e2e-consumer
description: The mion half of the pre-publish e2e: a real project consuming the PUBLISHED @mionjs/* from the local verdaccio. Deliberately declares NO @mionjs/* dependency — the lane installs all eleven from the registry at run time (scripts/release/e2e.mjs), so the install itself exercises npm resolution, including each packed @mionjs/* pulling its exact sibling @mionjs/* from the same registry. Boots the server through @mionjs/devtools' managed vite-node child, round-trips JSON + binary, inspects the installed tarballs, and asserts the production build inlines the compiled types and the harvested serverMapFrom mappers.
